title: Course Schedule
description: There are a total of numCourses courses you have to take, labeled from 0 to numCourses - 1. You are given an array prerequisites where prerequisites[i] = [ai, bi] indicates that you must take course bi first if you want to take course ai. Return true if you can finish all courses. Otherwise, return false.
hints: This is a cycle detection problem on a directed graph.
Build an adjacency list, then use DFS with visited states: unvisited, in-stack, done.

optimalSolution.approach: Build adjacency list. DFS with 3-state coloring: 0=unvisited, 1=in-stack (cycle if revisited), 2=done. Return false if any cycle detected.

followUpQuestions: What is the difference between topological sort and cycle detection?
Could you solve this with Kahn's algorithm (BFS)?
What is the time complexity and why?
interviewerNotes: Critical graph problem. Tests understanding of directed graph cycle detection and DFS state management. SDE-1 and above should solve this. Look for correct 3-state visited approach.
